programs.title: Farmhouse Fixer: Camp Revamp
programs.desc: Jon is hit with a gut-wrenching decision to either repair or tear down a damaged cabin; Jon's mom and sister help transform a mouse-infested nightmare into a romantic couple's cabin, and the ultimate glam-up includes a shower built for two.

programs.title: Farmhouse Fixer: Camp Revamp

programs.title: Help! I Wrecked My House
programs.desc: After thirteen years of weekend warrior renovations, a couple get so impatient with their lack of progress that they demolish almost every room in their house; Jasmine has seven weeks to tackle their upstairs bedrooms and main bathroom.

programs.title: Help! I Wrecked My House
programs.desc: A couple bought a fixer-upper in their dream neighborhood with hopes of making it their forever home, but DIY attempts have been disastrous; Jasmine has nine weeks to transform their kitchen, living room and playroom into a light and beachy space.

programs.title: Fixer to Fabulous
programs.desc: A couple with Australian roots wants to brighten up their dull '80s rancher and make it better reflect their family's lifestyle; Dave and Jenny give all the kids a special space of their own and update the home with some Aussie inspired touches.

programs.title: Fixer to Fabulous
programs.desc: The Marrs team up with volunteers to remodel a home for a family who have faced difficult health battles; with only 24 hours at hand, they struggle against the clock as well as the challenging weather to give the family the support they deserve.
